data.gender_notes: AlIyadith is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Al-'A-'A-D-A, meaning to lead, guide, or show the way. This name is of great significance in Islamic history as it is the title of many scholars, leaders, and saints who have guided the ummah (Muslim community) towards truth and righteousness. The name AlIyadith carries the meaning “Leader, Guide” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlIyadith usually hope their child will grow to embody leader, guide and live with faith, good character and purpose.
